appropriate_uses: U.S. professional reporting on official claims, security chronology, and attributed national-security accounts.
inappropriate_uses: Treating anonymous official sourcing as direct proof, or counting CBS rewrites and partner republication as independent chains.
known_failure_modes: Anonymous official-source dependence; security-context compression; follow-up updates can alter article framing.
name: CBS News
observables: reported official claims, security chronology, U.S. policy and national-security reporting
originating_chain_rule: Treat each CBS article as one chain unless separate original reporting and source access are documented; CBS partner syndications do not add independence.

review_history.note: Added for VER-20260813-01 Air Force One warning/deception packet; use is limited to attributed reporting and event chronology.
